notes.title: Version 0.14.0
notes.notes:
[EN] Hello everyone! 😈
Main game update available! 

Class and weapon upgrade menus have been upgraded.
The new "Challenges" game mode is now playable and the "Survival" game mode has been greatly reworked and completed.
Other minor mechanics have been corrected and perfected.

The game is still available on Steam in Early Access (link in bio)

We look forward to your feedback!
Enjoy the experience!🔥

notes.title: Version 0.10.2
notes.notes:
[u][b]News:[/b][/u]
- It is now possible to change the game language to English
- New variations of demons have been added to the game.

[u][b]Corrections:[/b][/u]
- Options are now also available in the agent menu.
- Barrier collision height has been increased to prevent players from jumping over them.

notes.title: Version 0.10.0
notes.notes:
[u][b]News:[/b][/u]
- Co-op is now available, so you can play with two players.
    > New buttons are accessible for this when you choose your game mode in the main menu.
    > Saves are now functional for the second player.
    > Class and weapon upgrades are now unique for each player.
    > Blood is obtainable by the nearest player, steal or share, the choice is yours.
    > The reward message at the end of the game is well displayed for each player and the content specific to this one.
- It is now possible to create various agents in the menu who will each have their levels of weapons and classes in game.
- Aiming is now available with every weapon in the game.
- Various options like sensitivity and FOV are now adjustable from the options menu.
- New music is available in menus and in-game.
- The Map has been greatly improved, filled and separated into various areas to avoid giving too much freedom to the player.
- The weapon and class upgrade menus and their feedback have been greatly improved.
- Demon waves now have a "random" factor and new variations of demons are coming.
- An early release alert message with the option to join the discord will appear when the player launches the game for the very first time.
- The joystick allows you to move correctly in the main menus.
- Each of the classes now has a corresponding color.
- The tombs allowing to receive blood have been removed because not necessary.
- Doors now open much faster.

[u][b]Corrections:[/b][/u]
- Fixed multiplayer issues.
    > It is no longer possible for the second player to shoot while running.
    > 2nd player reloading and stabbing issues have been fixed.
    > Second player regeneration works again.
- The screen no longer darkens when moving away from the artifact at the start of rounds.
- Most options are now correctly displayed and saved.
- Reload and movement speed is now consistent with animations, regardless of class or weapon level.
- Some menu prices not corresponding to the display have been corrected.
- The weapon save system has been optimized and improved.
- Collisions that could block some daemons have been worked on.
- The class ultimate is no longer available from the start and without the corresponding class improvement.
- Each class upgrade is only available once.
- The demon spawn points are connected to each of the openable doors.
- The price of openable doors is correctly displayed.
- Automatic reloading is functional again.
- It is no longer possible to shoot during a weapon change.
- All the demons are present in the game and it is again possible to hit the Chopper (large demon with 4 arms).
- It is no longer necessary that only the player with the artifact can open the doors.
